security.csp: default-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:*; connect-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:*; img-src 'self' data: blob: http://127.0.0.1:*; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' http://127.0.0.1:*; script-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:*; font-src 'self' data: http://127.0.0.1:*

bundle.longDescription: RagVault is a self-hosted, RAG-powered AI study companion. Upload PDF (including scans), PowerPoint, Word, Markdown, text or CSV material, then ask questions, generate notes and quizzes, and get a study plan built from the questions you missed.
